fieldValues.title: Decision records are formed weakly
fieldValues.statement: Decisions are recorded quickly but thinly: 'policy' is a catch-all for 24 of 47 programme decisions, none is scoped to a domain, and 22 record no alternatives. A later choice cannot tell what a decision weighed, where it holds, or when it should be revisited.
source_ref: Flow model B, stage Rule (container b9c5106b)
